title: A Course in Steady Soul Mending
summary: A course that builds on the first primers with deeper mends and the first rinse for a soul fouled by a lingering taint.

title: The Soul Mender's Intermediate Handbook
summary: A working handbook for the mender who now sets splints and fills the hollows left by hard blows to the spirit.

title: Treatise on Clearing the Spirit
summary: A treatise on lifting dust and residue from the soul and on rinsing it clean after a long strain.

title: The Grafting Canon
summary: A canon that treats a torn soul like living wood and teaches the graft and the splice to join what was parted.

title: A Manual of Quiet Remedies
summary: A manual of mild remedies for the soul that favours slow doses and the drawing off of a soul-borne poison.

title: The Bright Tending Course
summary: A course in keeping the lamp of a wounded soul alight and in clearing the soot that dims it.

title: Lessons on the Knitted Soul
summary: Lessons that teach the loose knit and the tight knit and the careful picking out of a bad stitch.
